records.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
records.application_period: There is only one application deadline each year. For 2026/2027: find the chosen programme November-December 2025, contact the Sending Partner and register/upload documents in December 2025, submit by 15 January 2026, 2 p.m. CET; Sending Partner nomination lists February 2026; supervisor statement for doctoral applicants until 15 March 2026; entrance exams March-May 2026; results by end of June/beginning of July 2026.

records.title: Alberta Innovates Graduate Student Scholarships
records.official_source: Alberta Innovates (Government of Alberta provincial agency), delivered through participating Alberta post-secondary institutions
records.deadline_display: No single calendar deadline is published. The Alberta Innovates programme page gives the due date as "Continuous" and states "This program is accepting applications on a seasonal basis. Intake Open Date is specific to each individual university; please contact your university of choice for deadline information." At the University of Calgary, "The Graduate Award Competition opens November 1 of each year" and "Deadlines vary by program"; the Faculty of Graduate Studies reference deadline is February 1.
records.application_period: Continuous at the funder level, with a seasonal intake at each institution. Alberta Innovates publishes the due date as "Continuous". At the University of Calgary the Graduate Award Competition opens November 1 each year, program deadlines vary and must be confirmed with Graduate Program Staff, and results for the Alberta Innovates competition are announced September to December. Awards are paid in the following academic year, with the majority starting in September.

records.title: Qatar University International Students Scholarship
records.official_source: Qatar University, Office of the Vice President for Student Affairs — Scholarships Section
records.deadline_display: Online scholarship applications run 1–25 March each year (2026 cycle: 1 March – 25 March 2026)
records.application_period: Scholarship applications are submitted through the Qatar University online admission application during the announced annual period, which the official Scholarship Timeline page lists as 1 March to 25 March.
